info.name: CourseGap Companion - REST API Practice Collection
info.description:
Postman Collection for testing student REST endpoints powered by JSON Server on http://localhost:3000/students.

Recommended Execution Order:
1. GET /students (Fetch all students)
2. POST /students (Create a test student S105)
3. GET /students/:id (Retrieve single student e.g., S101 or S105)
4. PUT /students/:id (Full replacement of student S105)
5. PATCH /students/:id (Partial update of attendance/status on S102)
6. HEAD /students (Inspect headers and status without body)
7. DELETE /students/:id (Delete test student S105)

request.description:
Retrieves the complete array of student records from JSON Server.
Expected Status: 200 OK
Expected Response: JSON Array of all students.

Retrieves a specific student record by ID (e.g. S101).
Expected Status: 200 OK
Expected Response: JSON Object for student S101.

body.raw:
{
  "id": "S105",
  "name": "Vikramaditya Rao",
  "semester": 5,
  "department": "Computer Science & Engineering",
  "email": "vikram.rao@example.com",
  "attendance": 91,
  "status": "On Track",
  "subjects": [
    "Artificial Intelligence",
    "Web Technologies",
    "Cloud Infrastructure"
  ]
}

request.description:
Adds a new student record (S105) to the JSON database.
Expected Status: 201 Created
Expected Response: JSON Object of the newly created student record.

body.raw:
{
  "id": "S105",
  "name": "Vikramaditya Rao",
  "semester": 6,
  "department": "Computer Science & Engineering",
  "email": "vikram.rao.updated@example.com",
  "attendance": 95,
  "status": "Excellent",
  "subjects": [
    "Artificial Intelligence",
    "Web Technologies",
    "Cloud Infrastructure",
    "Deep Learning"
  ]
}

request.description:
Completely replaces student record S105.
NOTE: PUT replaces the full entity. Any omitted field in the request body will be removed from the resource.
Expected Status: 200 OK
Expected Response: Complete updated JSON Object.

Partially updates specific fields (attendance and status) for student S102 without affecting other fields like name, department, or subjects.
Expected Status: 200 OK
Expected Response: Updated JSON Object with modified fields.

Inspects response headers and status for /students without fetching body content.
Expected Status: 200 OK
Expected Headers: Content-Type, Content-Length, Cache-Control, Access-Control-Allow-Credentials, Date.
Expected Body: Empty (0 bytes).

Deletes the test student record (S105).
IMPORTANT PRE-REQUISITE: Always run request #3 (POST /students) to create test student S105 prior to executing DELETE to avoid removing base data.
Expected Status: 200 OK (or 204 No Content)
Expected Response: Empty object `{}` or no content.
